mapper.update: UPDATE rwd_grant_record SET status = 'PERMANENT_FAILED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('GRANTED', 'WON', 'CLAIMING', 'RETRY_PENDING', 'PENDING')

UPDATE rwd_grant_record SET prize_code = #{row.prizeCode}, category_code = #{row.categoryCode}, face_fen = #{row.faceFen}, cost_fen = #{row.costFen}, recon_status = #{row.reconStatus}, status = #{row.status}, fulfillment_status = #{row.fulfillmentStatus}, fulfillment_ref = #{row.fulfillmentRef}, fail_reason = #{row.failReason}, fulfill_fail_reason = #{row.fulfillFailReason}, retry_count = #{row.retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{row.nextRetryAt}, next_fulfill_retry_at = #{row.nextFulfillRetryAt}, expire_at = #{row.expireAt}, claimed_at = #{row.claimedAt}, granted_at = #{row.grantedAt}, fulfilled_at = #{row.fulfilledAt}, simulated = #{row.simulated}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE rwd_grant_record SET status = 'CLAIMING', retry_count = CASE WHEN status = 'RETRY_PENDING' THEN retry_count + 1 ELSE retry_count END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('WON', 'RETRY_PENDING') AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > #{now}) AND (status <> 'RETRY_PENDING' OR retry_count < #{retryMax})

UPDATE rwd_grant_record SET fulfillment_status = #{row.fulfillmentStatus}, fulfill_fail_reason = #{row.fulfillFailReason}, fulfillment_ref = #{row.fulfillmentRef}, fulfilled_at = #{row.fulfilledAt}, recon_status = #{row.reconStatus}, retry_count = #{row.retryCount}, next_fulfill_retry_at = #{row.nextFulfillRetryAt}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id} AND fulfillment_status = #{expectedFulfillment}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rwd_grant_record WHERE status = 'GRANTED' AND fulfillment_status = 'SENDING' AND next_fulfill_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_fulfill_retry_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_fulfill_retry_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM rwd_grant_record WHERE status = 'GRANTED' AND fulfillment_status = 'SENDING' AND recon_status = 'NONE' AND granted_at IS NOT NULL AND granted_at < #{dayStart} ORDER BY granted_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rwd_grant_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
AND (status IN ('WON', 'CLAIMING', 'RETRY_PENDING') OR (status = 'GRANTED' AND fulfillment_status IN ('SENDING', 'FULFILL_FAILED')))

SELECT category_code AS categoryCode, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fulfillment_status = 'ARRIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS arrivedCount, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fulfillment_status = 'ARRIVED' THEN cost_fen ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS arrivedCostFen, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fulfillment_status = 'SENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS sendingCount, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fulfillment_status = 'SENDING' THEN cost_fen ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS sendingCostFen FROM rwd_grant_record WHERE simulated = 0 AND fulfillment_status IN ('ARRIVED', 'SENDING') AND category_code = #{categoryCode} AND prize_id = #{prizeId} AND granted_at >= #{from} AND granted_at < #{to} GROUP BY category_code ORDER BY category_code ASC
